scope: Primary-source mechanism review. No third-party inference, credentials, image upload or source redistribution.

labels.documented: Explicit primary-source statement or inspected original code
labels.inferred: Our engineering deduction, not attributed competitor behavior

sources.title: Digitizing paper ECGs at scale: an open-source algorithm for clinical research
sources.documented: Published main uses global perspective correction and autocorrelation scale, not a validated local TPS rectifier.
sources.limit: Waveform evaluation is not dense geometry metrology. Full text also read from local M3 paper.xml.

sources.title: Open-ECG-Digitizer official main branch metadata
sources.retrieval: GitHub connector GET branch metadata, checked 2026-10-23
sources.documented: Same main SHA as frozen M3 source.

sources.title: Open-ECG-Digitizer README, presets and experimental Dewarper
sources.documented: Experimental dewarping is not formally evaluated and is off in official presets. TPS subsamples controls randomly and has an identity fallback.
sources.limit: An optional experimental arm must not be presented as the published main method.

sources.title: High precision ECG digitization using artificial intelligence
sources.documented: Grid normalization and subsequent waveform reconstruction are different stages.
sources.limit: Full preprint read in M3. Commercial release identity and dense coordinate scores are not provided by the abstract or summary.

sources.title: US20240144417A1: Methods for generating an image of a graphical representation
sources.documented: Probabilistic directional edges, closed cycles, BFS network selection, missing-node regression and per-cell original color sampling.
sources.limit: Examples are not verified settings of the commercial implementation. No legal interpretation is supplied.

sources.title: US12614244B2: Methods for generating an undistorted image from a distorted original image of a graphical representation
sources.documented: Cell correspondence and inverse source sampling are disclosed. Four-corner operator wording does not uniquely identify all numerical conventions.
sources.limit: Does not identify current product build, checkpoint, TPS or geometric benchmark score.

sources.title: Powerful Medical public OpenAPI snapshot audited in M3
sources.documented: M3 snapshot exposes digitization endpoints, build metadata and warnings, with no Dotter/Gridder dense geometry export.
sources.limit: Snapshot evidence only. No authentication or inference call in M4. Do not equate documented API with executed commercial results.

sources.title: Tang third-place Kaggle source audited in M3
sources.documented: Semantic line IDs and lead markers depend on supported template.
sources.limit: Bounded to this authentic arm. Not all Kaggle solutions or the first-place method. Dedicated Kaggle M4 review owns broader comparison.

sources.title: Calibration Wizard: A Guidance System for Camera Calibration Based on Modelling Geometric and Corner Uncertainty
sources.documented: Accounts for corner localization uncertainty in geometric estimation.
sources.inferred: ECG frontend should separate anisotropic localization covariance from correspondence and pitch uncertainty.
sources.limit: Camera calibration paper, not an ECG evaluation.

sources.title: Revisiting Document Image Dewarping by Grid Regularization
sources.documented: Uses boundary/text-line constraints in grid optimization.
sources.limit: Readability scores do not establish metric ECG calibration.

sources.title: UVDoc: Neural Grid-based Document Unwarping
sources.documented: Coupled coarse 2D/3D grid training and a UV-reference capture pipeline.
sources.availability: Official code and LICENSE inspected. Checkpoint model/best_model.pkl confirmed by inventory: 32158393 bytes, Git blob 418108b3fcc9b49df64cb3bae0f5506b3e406934. No download or execution.
sources.limit: Full visibility/no occlusion assumption. Read README benchmark erratum before reproducing scores.

sources.title: Deep Unrestricted Document Image Rectification (DocTr++)
sources.documented: Hierarchy and mapping definition support complete, partial or missing document boundaries.
sources.limit: Not an independently calibrated ECG geometry method.

sources.title: DocMatcher: Document Image Dewarping via Structural and Textual Line Matching
sources.documented: Matches structural/textual lines to a known template.
sources.availability: Code and LICENSE inspected. models.yaml links DocMatcher SAM/Lineformer/LightGlue weights. No download or execution.
sources.limit: Template match validity is an additional hypothesis, not universal ECG layout support.

sources.title: ForCenNet: Foreground-Centric Network for Document Image Rectification
sources.documented: Foreground mask and curvature supervision for reference elements.
sources.availability: Only README.md and assets at root of consulted official snapshot. No executable comparator demonstrated.
sources.limit: Preserving physiological curvature is different from straightening document lines.

sources.title: D2Dewarp: Dual Dimensions Geometric Representation Learning Based Document Image Dewarping
sources.documented: Separate H/V line decoder heads and feature fusion.
sources.availability: train.py, predict.py and networks inventoried. README explicitly declares CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and links pretrained weights on Drive/Baidu. No download or execution.
sources.limit: H/V evidence alone does not assign ECG metric line IDs.

sources.title: DvD: Unleashing a Generative Paradigm for Document Dewarping via Coordinates-based Diffusion Model
sources.venue: 2025 preprint. Venue not independently verified in this bounded review.
sources.documented: Denoises warp coordinates rather than RGB.
sources.limit: Abstract-level mechanism checked. No model execution or uncertainty calibration verified.

sources.title: Geometric Rectification of Creased Document Images based on Isometric Mapping
sources.documented: Uses isometric/developable geometry and feature lines for creases.
sources.limit: Abstract-level mechanism checked. No authentic implementation executed.

sources.title: SyntheticDoc: A Large Synthetic Dataset for Document Unwarping and Illumination Correction
sources.venue: ECCV 2026, oral according to official ETH page
sources.documented: Physics-based generation and rich dense annotations at scale.
sources.availability: generation, training, DATASET.md and LICENSE inventoried. README confirms image/albedo/shading/UV/backward-map/metadata release, with normals and 3D coordinates still pending. No dataset download or inference.
sources.limit: Large storage cost and camera/viewpoint scope remain. Not ECG clinical validation.

sources.title: TextFlow: Textline-guided Generic Document Image Unwarping
sources.documented: README describes unwarped text-map auxiliary supervision.
sources.availability: README, assets and textflow.py inventoried. No run or full pipeline audit.

sources.title: ECG-image-database: large-scale paired ECG images and time-series with real-world artifacts; a foundation for computerized ECG digitization and analysis
sources.documented: Same Ahus/Emory/PTB-XL image family associated with npj and challenges.
sources.limit: Do not call automatically independent because of a new publication date. Direct PMC open returned a browser challenge.

retrieval_limits: CVF direct PDF and some HTML opens returned 403 or timeout, although primary indexed abstracts were retrievable. Author arXiv and official project pages were used for method details.
NPJ branch metadata was re-read through the purpose-built GitHub connector.
No broad patent novelty or legal freedom-to-operate search was performed.
No raw external paper, code, dataset, vendor JavaScript or OpenAPI response was copied into the deliverable.
